_about: The $baransu:draw book index: one topic per chapter (and per API row, list item, command line or line range where one chapter holds several tools). scripts/lookup.py <id> prints only that part; --log appends the lookup to <output>/docs/lookups.log; --render-index regenerates references/INDEX.md from this file; --rebuild-index re-indexes from the current headings; --check proves every entry resolves, every heading is reached and no topic prints more than 120 lines. Fields: id, title, area, keywords, file (relative to the skill root), heading (exact heading text; null = whole file), and optionally parent (enclosing heading when the text repeats), row (first table cell, exact or unique prefix), item (start of a list item), match (substrings of lines to print), from/to (a line range: start of its first line, start of the first line after it), aliases, overview (prints the opening text and the sub-topic ids), whole + whole_reason (prints its sub-headings as one unit).

areas.shared: Every run: the step guide (SKILL.md), the critique loop and scorecards, the pause classification.
areas.diagram: Diagram system (vendored diagram-design): types, tokens, primitives, layout, sizes, import, export, brand skins, taste gate.
areas.map: Map form (vendored archify): authoring, contracts, finalize and delivery, viewer runtime.
areas.motion: Motion form: the five phases, camera, transitions, springs, composition, type, sound, render pipeline, finishing.
areas.component: Component form: one interactive figure in its own file — mechanics, component contract, performance, build order, the $baransu:ui hand-off.
areas.mechanism: Mechanism approach: the $baransu:draw router and overrides, the collection catalog, the Anatomy landing page.
areas.anatomy: Mechanism approach: the vendored Anatomy skill — workflow, craft, motion, verify, WebGL, 3D, walkthrough.
areas.kit: Mechanism approach: the Anatomy kit API, one topic per section and one per function or tool row.
areas.collection: Mechanism approach: the 52 vendored collection pages, one topic per page.
